productConcept.name: Veridian Instruments
productConcept.description: Precision analog measurement instruments — aneroid barometers, hygrometers, and thermograph recorders — built by hand in a Dresden workshop since 1931.
productConcept.rationale: The copper-still design system's warm neutral palette (#4e4946 body, #ffffff background), Cormorant Garamond display type, letterpress-referencing dial typography, editorial 807px container, and measured ×1.3 motion pacing all map precisely to a workshop craft context. The 'copper' in the system name is literal: hammered copper surfaces as instrument material. The design avoids all clichéd French atelier / editorial magazine directions; instead grounds the aesthetic in Central European precision craft — equally authentic to the same typographic vocabulary.
